tactics.title: Tactics board
tactics.name: Plan name
tactics.noLevel: Load a level under Level to plan on it; without one the board is a flat plane.
tactics.hint.select: Click a figure, waypoint, arrow, area or note to select it; Shift+click adds or removes, Shift+drag draws a box.
tactics.hint.place: Click the level to put the chosen figure there. R turns it.
tactics.hint.arrow: Click points along the way. Started on a figure, the arrow is its route in this step and it walks it when played.
tactics.hint.throw: Click the thrower, then where it lands; the chosen utility appears there.
tactics.hint.area: Click the middle, then the edge.
tactics.hint.erase: Click a figure, arrow, area or note to remove it from this step on.
tactics.hint.moving: Click where the selected figure goes in this step.
tactics.hint.finish: Enter, double click or right click ends it; Esc drops it.
tactics.figureScaleHint: 1× is true size; larger reads better from far above.
tactics.label: Label
tactics.clearConfirm: Clear the whole plan? Undo brings it back.
tactics.file.bad: That file is not a plan this viewer reads: {reason}
tactics.addStep: Add a step; figures start it where their routes ended
tactics.valorant.failed: Could not fetch the maps from valorant-api.com: {reason}
tactics.gizmo.title: Transform
tactics.gizmo.hint: Drag an arrow to move along it, a square across its plane, the centre over the level; rings turn. Hold Ctrl to snap to the grid or the angle step. Esc cancels a drag.
tactics.speed.source.official: Speeds from the game's published values (see Movement speeds in the docs).
tactics.speed.source.approx: Approximate speeds (measured or typical; see Movement speeds in the docs). Set your own where you know better.
tactics.route.title: Route: {total} s, there at {at}
tactics.timing.title: Timing
tactics.timing.realTime: Play in real time (a step lasts until its slowest route arrives)
tactics.timing.hint: Times follow the level's surface and slope at each mode's speed for the figure; CS2 maps are in game units (39.37 a metre).
tactics.timeline.title: Arrivals
tactics.tele.title: Compare with match data
tactics.tele.hint: Load CS2 match tables of this map (or use the loaded data) to see how fast players really got where your plan goes.
tactics.tele.error: Could not read the match data: {reason}
tactics.tele.noRounds: the loaded data has no round times
tactics.tele.speedsHint: Real speeds in m/s, between samples while moving.
tactics.tele.noStates: The data has no movement state (walking, crouching) columns.
tactics.tele.compareHint: Select a routed figure or its route to compare its time with what players achieved.
tactics.tele.compare: Fastest observed {fastest} s ({who}), p10 {p10} s, median {median} s over {n} runs; your plan {plan} s.
tactics.tele.none: No player in the data went from there to there.
